question: Who among the following has been elected the President of the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for 2025–26?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Memani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajiv Memani**, the **Chairman and CEO** of **EY India**, has been elected as the **President-Designate** of the **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** for the year **2024-25**.
 
• According to the organizational hierarchy and succession planning of the **CII**, the **President-Designate** typically assumes the office of the **President** in the subsequent year, making him the **President** for **2025–26**.
 
• Memani is a prominent leader in the professional services sector and serves as a member of the **EY Global Management Body**. 
 
• He also chairs the **EY Global Emerging Markets Committee**, bringing extensive experience in **taxation**, **technology**, and **corporate governance** to the industry body.
